description: Upgrade plan to migrate project to JDK 25

tasks.reason: Upgrade to the latest Java LTS version (JDK 25) for improved performance, security patches, and long-term support.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade JDK to version 25. Update compiler source and target levels to 25. Update build tool configuration (Maven/Gradle) to target JDK 25. Resolve any compilation issues arising from deprecated or removed APIs in newer Java versions.
